TimestampBasis gains SuppliedUnknown; both supplied-string read paths use it (Deserialize at model.rs:224 and projected_value_from_json at model.rs:1006), neither hardcodes Native. FormatLoss gains TimestampBasis. Timestamp-bearing datasets declare lossy:true with LOSSES_TIMESTAMP_* on Json, Jsonl, Csv, Table, Text and Markdown, while SOURCE_FORMATS correctly keeps Json/Jsonl lossy:false because sources declare no Timestamp-typed field and no default time field. Paired validators implement exactly the requested discrimination rather than a blanket substitution: public validate() passes RecoveryAction::ReadQueryHelp while dataset-aware validate_for(dataset) passes ConsultSchema{dataset} (model.rs:331 and :334, same pattern at :250, :281, :333). invalid_time() uses ReadQueryHelp because a Timestamp has no dataset. Timestamp drops the derived comparison and implements PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd and Ord manually over unix_nanos only (model.rs:197-212), with the doc comment stating that basis is never compared. This restores C10's stable entity-ID tie break and makes serialize/deserialize identity-preserving under equality despite the SuppliedUnknown downgrade. C10 amended to state the rule. new_findings.title: C21 still enumerates FormatLoss as four variants while C10 v6 and the code require five
evidence: C21 v6 reads FormatLoss=AbsenceNullEmptyCollapse|StructuredAsJsonText|HumanRounding|PresentationOnly, unchanged from v5.
C10 v6 requires 'Formats that omit basis declare FormatLoss::TimestampBasis and lossy=true for timestamp-bearing datasets, including JSON/JSONL'.
crates/core/src/query/schema.rs:28 declares five variants including TimestampBasis => "timestamp_basis".
new_findings.consequence: Two contracts in the sealed guide contradict each other, and the one that is wrong is C21, whose specific job is freezing the type vocabulary that wave1 lanes read. The code is correct and self-consistent, and a coder building an exhaustive match from C21 would get a compile error rather than wrong behaviour, which is why this is low and not blocking.
new_findings.required_resolution: Append |TimestampBasis to C21's FormatLoss enumeration before the seal record is written.

oracle_assessment.grade: condition 1 met - regression oracle, not specification oracle
oracle_assessment.independent_third_derivation: This reviewer rebuilt the C25 encoding from the contract rules and declared inputs in a separate kernel, without executing the delivered script, and obtained source_id q1:source:aea024db164980dee299775e2ca50ec8c6cbb4a0607aa1300f84bb46951e678b, preimage exactly 972 bytes and sha256 23c71eb09affec419f8bf44180fcb9b975d9ead38351be921688a1b904d0ae35.
oracle_assessment.vector_is_live: digest() emits exactly the ten member names in exactly the encoded order, so the constant binds the encoder rather than being self-consistent in isolation; the committed test hardcodes the literal rather than recomputing it.
oracle_assessment.limitation: Execution independence is provable from the artifact; derivation independence is not, since a script transcribed from fingerprint.rs would look identical. The vector therefore catches widening and accidental encoder change but not a specification misreading shared by both implementations; that residue is closed by this reviewer's direct reading of the encoder against C25, not by the vector.
oracle_assessment.chronology: Recorded as an attestation and explicitly labelled 'This record is a later reproduction, not claimed earlier evidence.' That framing is correct and is what makes the artifact usable.
oracle_assessment.maintenance_rule: The constant must never be regenerated from code output; a disagreement requires an encoder fix or an explicit C25 amendment. PM has accepted this and will carry it into the SDK task handoff.
